name: ImageEditorView
description: A full workspace made from public parts; no persistence or file transport is implicit.

props.name: backend
props.description: Force a renderer; auto chooses the available backend.

props.name: collapseBelow
props.description: Width below which panes use the shared sheet-and-strip layout. Defaults to 64rem.

props.name: commands
props.description: Host-supplied command definitions; matching ids replace built-ins.

props.name: editor
props.description: Host owns this session and its lifetime.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ workspace: string; library: string; file: string; edit: string; view: string; help: string; history: string; presets: string; layers: string; filmstrip: string; original: string; step: string; settings: string; develop: string; geometry: string; retouch: string; effects: string; files: string; docked: string; focus: string; compare: string; before: string; after: string; shortcuts: string; commands: string; nextRegion: string; previousRegion: string; unavailable: string; pan: string; open: string; save: string; export: string; copy: string; paste: string; recover: string; recovery: string; failed: string; autosave: string; noAutosave: string; templates: string; photo: string; custom: string; engine: string; singleSlider: string; avatar: string; product: string; social: string; annotator: string; developView: string; fullSuite: string; format: string; demo: string; resetLayout: string; showPane: (pane: string) => string; hidePane: (pane: string) => string; }> | undefined

props.name: onSelectedPictureIdChange
props.description: Reports a filmstrip choice. Host switches editor without disposing other sessions.

props.name: onWorkspaceChange
props.description: Completed layout and mode changes; the host may store this value.

props.name: presets
props.description: Optional host presets. Rendering parts must belong to the supplied tools.

props.name: shortcuts
props.type: Readonly<Record<string, string | readonly string[] | null>> | undefined
props.description: Key overrides by action id (for example edit.undo or tool.crop); [] disables a binding.

props.name: slots
props.description: Replacement regions. null intentionally empties a region.

props.name: tools
props.description: Only these tools, sections and layer panels appear.

props.name: workspace
props.description: Controlled workspace; nothing is persisted internally.
